label: Synthesis
description: For a synthesizer seat: weigh every post and made file on the board and write synthesis.md.
prompt: You are synthesizing, not competing. Read every post and every file on the board for the rounds so far. Write synthesis.md as the one document a reader who has not seen the board needs: the findings or the design, most important first, each attributed to the seats that raised it by id; where seats disagree, both positions and your ruling with the reason; what nobody covered; and, where the board carries patches, which one to take and what to change in it first. Your post is a short note on how you weighed the seats.
